task.title: Archive, restore, permanently delete, or reset profiles
task.shortdesc: Use destructive profile lifecycle endpoints with explicit review and recovery records.

prereq.p: Confirm the target profile ID, current lifecycle state, and external approval record before calling destructive endpoints.

context.p: This task covers API-PROFILE-006, API-PROFILE-007, API-PROFILE-008, and API-PROFILE-009. BPM 0.9.0 has no bulk confirmation token, no undo endpoint for permanent delete, and no transaction rollback across operations.

step.cmd: Archive a profile when you need to remove it from active workflows while preserving it for review.

info.note: Archive is a destructive lifecycle change for active workflows. Record the approval reason and profile ID before the call.
info.p: Request example: DELETE $BPM_BASE_URL/api/profiles/42. Response example: 204 with no JSON body. Error examples: 404 missing profile or 422 invalid path input.

step.cmd: Restore an archived profile only after checking whether the name and profile purpose are still valid.

info.p: Request example: POST $BPM_BASE_URL/api/profiles/42/restore. Response example: 200 ProfileRead. Error examples: 404 profile cannot be restored or found; 422 invalid path input.

step.cmd: Permanently delete a profile only when the external retention policy allows removal.

info.note: Permanent delete removes an active or archived profile and has no BPM undo endpoint. Export or record required evidence before the call.
info.p: Request example: DELETE $BPM_BASE_URL/api/profiles/42/hard. Response example: 204 with no JSON body. Error examples: 404 missing profile or 422 invalid path input.

step.cmd: Reset the profile library only in disposable or explicitly approved environments.

info.note: Reset permanently deletes every profile in the Library and currently requires no confirmation token. Never use it as a routine synchronization shortcut.
info.p: Request example: DELETE $BPM_BASE_URL/api/profiles/reset. Response example: 200 {"deleted":3}. Error behavior: no application error is currently declared; database failures use framework handling.

step.cmd: After any destructive call, re-list profiles and read the affected record when applicable.

info.p: Request example: GET $BPM_BASE_URL/api/profiles?lifecycle=all. Response example: 200 ProfileRead[]. Error example: 422 invalid query input. Use this verification to update the integrating product's inventory state.

step.cmd: Write the external audit record with operation ID, HTTP method, path, profile ID, approver, reason, timestamp, response status, and recovery decision.

info.p: Expected result: a later reviewer can distinguish archive, restore, hard delete, and reset actions and can see why the integration considered the operation safe.

result.p: Destructive profile lifecycle operations are documented with request, response, error, warning, and recovery evidence.

postreq.p: If the approval record is missing, stop the integration workflow before calling permanent delete or reset.
